lens: Prospective client — keyboard-oriented use (simulated AI lens)
reason: The inspected public proposition explains student-led, semester-long consulting, useful outputs, no consulting fee, team size, confidentiality scoping and client responsibilities. The work-to-contact journey gives a client concrete prompts for a useful inquiry and identifies the board as recipient. Supplied homepage captures show coherent Precision Instrument hierarchy, clear actions and readable mobile composition. Native links, buttons, details/summary, labeled inputs, a skip link and explicit focus styles provide a credible keyboard foundation; the menu Escape check passed locally. However, the evidence does not demonstrate an end-to-end keyboard client journey or actual email delivery, and there is no approved engagement artifact with which to assess work quality. I cannot give unqualified world-class agreement or establish release readiness from this source/capture review. This is an AI assessment, not observed client success.

findings.evidence: PUBLIC_PROJECTS is empty. ClientProjectGrid displays organization descriptions and explicitly says project scope, methods, deliverables and outcomes are pending approval. WorkPage lines 56–63 omits Selected work when no public projects exist; the desktop capture confirms the homepage pending-approval state.
findings.userImpact: A client can establish organizational familiarity but cannot judge the quality or relevance of actual MECG analysis and handoff materials. This leaves the evidence-assessment part of the client task incomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain client and board approval for at least one bounded engagement account with its question, methods, limits and a redacted deliverable. Preserve the approval boundary and pending status until that evidence exists.

findings.evidence: The client journey clicks the FAQ and CTA, fills controls directly, clicks submit and intercepts /api/contact with a synthetic 200. The separate menu test manually focuses a link before Escape; it does not establish sequential keyboard traversal. The supplied log records both tests passing.
findings.userImpact: Passing checks do not establish that a keyboard-oriented client can traverse the proof controls and FAQ, reach the anchored form, correct invalid input and complete the inquiry with visible focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a focused keyboard-only local journey using Tab/Shift+Tab and Enter/Space, checking focus visibility and destination, FAQ activation, organization disclosure, validation recovery and status feedback. Keep actual email delivery as a separately verified integration gate.
